# Captured webcam regression frames

Small, unmodified provider previews retained solely for deterministic scoring regression tests. Source: [Windy Webcams](https://www.windy.com/webcams). No keys or signed image URLs are stored. These historical frames are not used by the public app or substituted for live images.

Original frames for Cape Town, Lajes do Pico and Law-Racoviță were unavailable. Synthetic golden-horizon, hazy-horizon and blue/snow fixtures cover analogous features; they are not presented as the original cameras.

`parentis-2026-09-11.jpg`: [Parentis-en-Born / Port du Piaou, Windy 1756332583](https://www.windy.com/webcams/1756332583), capture timestamp 2026-09-11T17:46:53Z. The user preferred this frame over Corneliano in the supplied calibration export. The fixture tests a strong luminous-sky alternative with Evidence still 18.5 at the recorded phase 65.3. The exact Corneliano frame from that comparison is unavailable, so the full original pair is not claimed as reproduced.

Additional negative: `berlin-artificial-lights-2026-09-11.jpg`, [Windy camera 1230040329](https://www.windy.com/webcams/1230040329), image timestamp 2026-09-11T17:56:59.000Z. The initial Phase 3.6 live inspection found this city-light false positive in the inherited chromatic path; the natural-sky guard rejects it.
